rows.note: Use this for trying to enter a romantic relationship with someone.

example.english: When I was trying to woo her, I often walked her home after work.
example.traditional: 我以前追求佢嗰陣，成日放工送佢返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 zeoi1 kau4 keoi5 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 fong3 gung1 sung3 keoi5 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for trying to win support, customers, or approval.

example.english: The company is doing everything it can to woo new customers.
example.traditional: 公司出盡方法爭取新客戶。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ceot1 zeon6 fong1 faat3 zang1 ceoi2 san1 haak3 wu6

rows.note: Use this when winning someone over to your side or cultivating their support, often with a slightly calculated tone.

example.english: He often takes his colleagues out for meals to woo them into supporting him.
example.traditional: 佢成日請同事食飯，想拉攏佢哋支持自己。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 cing2 tung4 si6 sik6 faan6 soeng2 laai1 lung2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 ci4 zi6 gei2
